export const meta = {
  name: 'panel-c-minors',
  description: 'Hard stop (c) minors: failing tests first (test-authz, test-concurrency), then backend fixer (slip cleanup on pre-auth failure) and UI robustness fixes',
  phases: [{ title: 'Test first' }, { title: 'Fix' }],
}
const COMMON = `Timed build lane. Working dir ./app. Source of truth ../BRIEF.md; ../SPEC.md; ../DECISIONS.md (D1-D63, all decided). The brief overrides CLAUDE.md where SPEC.md says so. One simple command per Bash call; never npm i; never commit; NEVER run supabase db reset; DB/test commands via bash ../scripts/with-db.sh <cmd>. Dev server runs at :3000 (hot reload; never start/kill it). Edit ONLY your listed files.`
const S = { type: 'object', properties: { status: { type: 'string' }, files_changed: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, checks_run: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, assumptions: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } }, required: ['status', 'files_changed', 'checks_run', 'assumptions'] }

phase('Test first')
const authzTests = agent(`${COMMON}
Files you may edit: tests/db/constraints.test.ts, tests/storage/** (new file tests/storage/slip-cleanup.test.ts is fine).
1. tests/db/constraints.test.ts ~329-333: the service_role DELETE on payments must assert exactly '42501' (D51 grant fact); keep the owner case asserting the trigger P0409.
2. NEW failing tests (R20 "If recording fails after the upload, the file must not be left behind"): as a fixture org's staff (tests/helpers createFixtureOrg + uploadSlip from tests/helpers/contract.ts or the storage client with the staff token), upload a slip to <org>/<lease>/<uuid>.png, then POST /api/leases/<random nonexistent uuid>/payments with { amountSen, method:'bank_transfer', receivedAt, slipPath } -> 404, and assert the object is GONE from storage.objects (pg). Same for: the lease of ANOTHER fixture org -> 404 and the slip (in the caller's own org folder) is gone; a valid lease but receivedAt without offset -> 400 and gone; malformed JSON body after upload -> 400 and gone if the path can be recovered — skip that last one if not recoverable, say so. Also assert a slip in ANOTHER org's folder is never deleted by such a failing request.
Run bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/db tests/storage — the 404 cleanup tests are expected to FAIL now (the route pre-authorizes outside the cleanup try); report exactly which fail.`,
  { agentType: 'test-authz', label: 'minorsC:test-authz', phase: 'Test first', schema: S })
const concTests = agent(`${COMMON}
Files you may edit: tests/webhook/**, tests/concurrency/**.
1. tests/webhook/gateway.test.ts ~167-176: duplicate keys -> assert exactly 401 + { error } body; rename the test to '... -> 401 (D52)'.
2. NEW DB-level boundary test (R30, D5): on a fixture lease (or inside BEGIN ... ROLLBACK with pg as postgres) with an invoice due on day D and nothing allocated, call private.create_gateway_bill(<tenant user id>, <lease id>, p_as_of) at (D-1)T15:59:59Z and at (D-1)T16:00:00Z (= D 00:00 Malaysia): the amount at the second instant is larger by exactly that invoice's amount (or the first gives P0422 'Nothing is due' when it is the first invoice). Use a transaction that rolls back so no bill rows persist, or accept the bills on the fixture lease.
Run bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/webhook tests/concurrency twice; report counts.`,
  { agentType: 'test-concurrency', label: 'minorsC:test-concurrency', phase: 'Test first', schema: S })
const ui = agent(`${COMMON}
Files you may edit: src/components/staff/**, src/components/tenant/**, src/components/app-shell/**, src/app/(app)/leases/[leaseId]/page.tsx, src/app/(app)/payments/return/page.tsx, src/app/login/**.
UI minors from the hard-stop (c) panel:
1. record-payment-form.tsx: remove the eslint-disable + useEffect default. Compute the default received-at on the server in src/app/(app)/leases/[leaseId]/page.tsx as formatInstantMyt(new Date()).slice(0, 16) (import from @/lib/dates) and pass it as a defaultReceivedAt prop used in useState; after a successful submit reset with the same helper. Server and client render the same string -> no hydration mismatch.
2. src/components/staff/api.ts: callApi must never leave a form stuck: a 2xx with an empty/non-JSON body -> { ok: false, error: 'Unexpected response from the server' }; every onSubmit/approve/reject/void handler resets its busy state in finally and toasts on any thrown error.
3. Never show raw PostgREST/Storage error text in toasts (phone-form.tsx ~39, record-payment-form.tsx ~120): map to fixed messages ('Your phone number could not be saved. Use digits, spaces or dashes, optionally starting with +.', 'Slip upload failed. Use a JPEG, PNG or PDF of at most 5 MB.'). API { error } messages from OUR routes may still be shown (they are written by us).
4. /payments/return: when there is no session, redirect to /login?next=<encoded /payments/return?bill_id=...>. The login form (src/components/app-shell/login-form.tsx or wherever it lives) accepts next ONLY if it starts with '/' and not '//' or '/\\' and contains no ':' before the first '/' (no scheme) — otherwise go to '/'. No open redirect.
Done means: npx tsc --noEmit and npx eslint . --max-warnings=0 clean (show output); curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' for /login, /leases, /tenant, /payments/return?bill_id=x still 200/307.`,
  { agentType: 'ui-builder', label: 'minorsC:ui-builder', phase: 'Fix', schema: S })

const t = await authzTests
phase('Fix')
const be = await agent(`${COMMON}
Files you may edit: src/app/api/leases/[leaseId]/payments/route.ts, src/server/services/payments.ts.
Fix (R20, panel c): the route pre-authorizes (requireUserId + authorizeRecordPayment, needed so 404/403 come before a malformed-JSON 400, D42) OUTSIDE recordPayment's slip-cleanup try, so a bank-transfer slip uploaded before a 401/403/404 (unknown lease, other org's lease, expired token) is left in Storage. Make the route read the raw body text first, then on ANY error after that point (authorization, JSON parse, validation, record) best-effort extract slipPath from the body (JSON.parse in try/catch, string only) and call the service's cleanup with the caller's own org: delete only when the caller is authenticated and is staff/manager of an org, the path starts with '<that org id>/', has no '..' or backslash, and no payments row references it (existing removeOrphanSlip guard). Never delete in another org's folder; never delete for an unauthenticated caller (no org to scope by). Keep the D42 order of status codes unchanged. Fix the misleading comment at payments.ts ~94.
The failing tests from test-authz are: ${JSON.stringify((t && t.checks_run) || [])}. Run bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/storage tests/contract tests/authz — all must pass (show counts), plus tsc + eslint clean.`,
  { agentType: 'fixer', label: 'minorsC:fixer', phase: 'Fix', schema: S })
const [c, u] = await Promise.all([concTests, ui])
return { authzTests: t, concTests: c, backend: be, ui: u }

authzTests.status:
Both parts are done. The run `bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/db tests/storage` ended with: "Test Files 1 failed | 2 passed (3)" / "Tests 2 failed | 92 passed | 1 skipped (95)".

Part 1: the service_role DELETE test in /home/electronica-care/ezy-prep/exam/app/tests/db/constraints.test.ts now expects exactly '42501', the D51 grant fact, and it passes. The owner test still expects the trigger's P0409, with and without session_replication_role = replica, and it passes.

Part 2: the new file /home/electronica-care/ezy-prep/exam/app/tests/storage/slip-cleanup.test.ts has 9 real tests and 1 skipped. Exactly 2 fail, as expected:
1. "nonexistent (well-formed) lease id -> 404 and the slip is gone": the response is 404 with a valid error body, but the slip is still in storage.objects.
2. "another org's lease -> 404 and the slip (in the caller's own org folder) is gone": same result, 404 and the slip is still there.

Cause: the route at src/app/api/leases/[leaseId]/payments/route.ts calls `authorizeRecordPayment(ctx, leaseId)` before `recordPayment`. The 404 is thrown outside recordPayment's cleanup try, so `removeOrphanSlip` never runs.

These pass:
- Own lease with receivedAt without an offset: 400 and the slip is gone.
- Malformed JSON: 400 JSON, and nothing is deleted.
- A slip in org B's folder is never deleted when org A's staff names it, in four cases: on A's lease with a bad receivedAt (400), on A's lease with a valid body (400), on B's lease (404), and on a nonexistent lease (404).
- A tenant naming a slip in its own org: 403, and the slip is kept.

Skipped: the malformed-JSON cleanup test. The slip path can't be recovered from a body that doesn't parse, so the server has nothing to delete. Only a sweeper could remove such orphans, and SPEC has none. This is a contract gap: R20 is not met for malformed bodies.
checks_run: bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/db tests/storage -> Test Files 1 failed | 2 passed (3); Tests 2 failed | 92 passed | 1 skipped (95). Failing: slip-cleanup.test.ts 'nonexistent (well-formed) lease id -> 404 and the slip is gone' and 'another org's lease -> 404 and the slip (in the caller's own org folder) is gone' (both: expected true to be false on objectExists after a 404). constraints.test.ts 'DELETE of a payment as service_role is refused by the grant (42501, D51)' passes.
assumptions: Malformed-JSON cleanup is not recoverable (the slipPath can't be read from an unparseable body), so it is it.skip. Instead the test asserts 400 JSON and that nothing is deleted. Nothing removes such orphans because SPEC has no sweeper; this is a contract gap against R20.
Slips are uploaded inline as PNG with the staff token through userClient storage, not with contract.ts uploadSlip (which uploads PDF), because the brief names <org>/<lease>/<uuid>.png.

A valid body naming a slip in another org's folder on the caller's own lease is expected to return 400 (SPEC: slip_path must be in its own org's folder, invalid input), and the other org's object must stay.

A tenant (no staff/manager membership) naming a staff-uploaded slip in its own org gets 403, and the slip must NOT be deleted, so a non-recorder can never delete a staff file. SPEC does not fix this; the case passes today.
All 404/403/400 bodies are also checked against the strict errorBody schema ({ error: string } only).

concTests.status: done. Both changes are in, and two full runs of tests/webhook and tests/concurrency (through with-db.sh) passed with the same summary line each time: "Test Files 3 passed (3) / Tests 49 passed (49)" (14.20s, then 21.07s). No test was flaky. (1) In /home/electronica-care/ezy-prep/exam/app/tests/webhook/gateway.test.ts, the duplicate-keys test (a repeated field, a repeated id, a repeated x_signature) now expects exactly 401 with the { error } body, then checks the bill is still pending with no payment. It is renamed '... -> 401 { error }, no effect (D52)'. I also corrected the stale 'SPEC: 400' wording in the test name; SPEC line 147 and D52 both say 401. (2) New file /home/electronica-care/ezy-prep/exam/app/tests/webhook/gateway-bill-boundary.test.ts, under describe 'R30 D5 amount due now turns over at 00:00 MYT (16:00Z the day before)'. It covers two leases: one starting on the 1st, and one anchored on the 31st so the Feb 28 month-end clamp is crossed. For every distinct due date D, it calls private.create_gateway_bill(tenant A user id, lease id, p_as_of) at (D-1)T15:59:59Z and at (D-1)T16:00:00Z. At 16:00:00Z the amount must equal the sum of the invoices due on or before D. For the first due date, the earlier instant must give P0422 'Nothing is due'. For each later date, the second amount must be larger by exactly the invoices due on D. Each call runs in its own BEGIN ... ROLLBACK on one pg connection, and the test then checks that the lease has 0 gateway_bills rows. No contract gap found: the function's behaviour matches SPEC line 198 and D5. Packages needed: none.
checks_run: bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/webhook/gateway-bill-boundary.test.ts -> Test Files 1 passed (1), Tests 2 passed (2)
bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/webhook tests/concurrency (run 1) -> Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 49 passed (49), 14.20s
bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/webhook tests/concurrency (run 2) -> Test Files 3 passed (3), Tests 49 passed (49), 21.07s
assumptions: The boundary test calls private.create_gateway_bill directly over a pg connection (the same role the existing forced-overlap tests use) and rolls back every call instead of going through HTTP. Why: HTTP cannot set p_as_of, and rolling back leaves no bill or audit rows behind. Rejected: keeping the bills on the fixture lease.

The expected amounts come from the fixture's own invoice list (sum of amount_sen with dueDate <= the MYT date, nothing allocated), not from hard-coded totals. This makes the test independent of how generateSchedule prorates the anchor-31 lease.
A second lease anchored on the 31st (2026-01-31..2026-04-29) was added beyond the brief's single-lease request. It also covers the boundary on clamped, non-1st due dates.
In the D52 test I corrected the stale wording ('SPEC: 400') in the name to '401 ... (D52)', matching SPEC line 147 and DECISIONS D52.

backend.status: Fixed. Cause: the route authorized (requireUserId + authorizeRecordPayment) outside recordPayment's cleanup try, so a 404/403 on the lease left the uploaded slip in Storage. After the fix, vitest on tests/storage, tests/contract and tests/authz shows 13 files passed and 353 tests passed (1 skipped). `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx eslint . --max-warnings=0` both print nothing. I did not re-run tests/db.
checks_run: bash ../scripts/with-db.sh npx vitest run tests/storage tests/contract tests/authz -> Test Files 13 passed (13); Tests 353 passed | 1 skipped (354)
assumptions: Fix, route.ts: after requireUserId (401, no cleanup because there is no org to scope by) the route reads req.text() first. Authorization, JSON parse, validation and recording now run in one try, and its catch calls cleanupRejectedSlip(ctx, text) and rethrows. The D42 status-code order is unchanged.

Fix, payments.ts: new exported cleanupRejectedSlip(ctx, rawBody). It extracts slipPath with JSON.parse in try/catch (string only), then loads the caller. It deletes only if the caller is staff or manager of an org, through the existing removeOrphanSlip guard. That guard requires the path to start with '<org>/', contain no '..' or backslash, and have no payments row referencing it. It never throws.
The comment at payments.ts ~94 now says authorization sits inside the try for direct service callers, and that the route pre-authorizes outside it and calls cleanupRejectedSlip itself.
recordPayment keeps its own cleanup, so a failed request can trigger cleanup twice. The second pass is harmless: either the object is already gone or a payment references it.

readJson in src/server/http.ts is not in my file list, so the route re-implements its three 400 messages inline (could not read, malformed JSON, not a JSON object). The messages are the same as readJson's. Consider letting readJson accept a text string later.
A tenant caller (no membership) never gets cleanup, because there is no org folder to scope by. Their slip, if any, stays in Storage.
No packages needed.

ui.status: Done: all 4 UI minors implemented. tsc and eslint clean. One open blocker for the lead on minor 4 (the (app) layout redirects to bare /login before the return page runs).
checks_run: curl /payments/return?bill_id=x: 307 to /login (without next, because src/app/(app)/layout.tsx redirects first)
assumptions: BLOCKER (outside my file list): src/app/(app)/layout.tsx redirects unauthenticated users to bare /login before the return page runs, so the page-level redirect with next= is never reached. Fix: let the lead or backend-engineer edit the layout to pass the requested path, or move payments/return outside the (app) group. The page redirect and the login form's next handling are ready for either option.

safeNextPath is stricter than the brief: it also rejects a backslash or control character anywhere in the path (browsers strip tabs and newlines in URLs, so '/<TAB>/evil.com' would become '//evil.com'); falls back to '/'.
Sign-in and sign-out toasts still show Supabase Auth error.message (outside the brief's PostgREST/Storage rule).
callApi treats a JSON null body on a 2xx as 'Unexpected response from the server'; no current route returns a bare null.
Extended try/catch/finally busy-state reset also to view-slip-button, login-form and sign-out-button, beyond the handlers the brief named.
No packages needed.
Not browser-tested with a seeded login; verified by tsc, eslint and curl status codes only.
